events.title: Our Kickstarter is live!
events.summary: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/obverse-games/the-crown-0 The Crown Prologue (demo) is our first foray onto Steam, and accompanies the Kickstarter we're running to accelerate development of the game. If you've been enjoying the demo, please consider pledging! You can pick up some merch, get Alpha or Beta early access to builds, and shape the game in many ways. As always, we're grateful for your feedback and interest.-Jon & everyone at Obverse

events.title: Demo Update 0.983.4
events.summary: Hi everyone.After feedback from players, here's a small update!Adjusted Thug story arc to be more realistic. Deebo story arc adjusted for clarity and a little longer now. Only takes one stealing event to trigger the Thieving story arc, to make it easier to find. Dealing Intro rewritten Dead people no longer paint murals Removed choice to protect the hood if you're an arsonist Arsonists can continue to pursue their careers in fiery mayhem after gaining the trait Various other small changes. events.title: Demo update 0.983
events.summary: Hi all! In response to feedback and internal testing, we have another update. This one makes the game significantly harder (stat rewards are smaller) which should bring the metaprogression closer to planned gameplay. Minor bugs, image and audio tweaks also happened.Please let us know how it's going! The forums, our new Discord: https://discord.gg/duX9k5AdN or feedback@adiuvat-consulting.com all work fine.-Jon

events.title: Demo update 0.982.2
events.summary: Hi all! In response to player feedback and also general testing, here's an update. It unlocks a major expansion of the Thieving storyline which concludes the planned demo content. If we add more stuff, it'll be in response to feedback!Expect another game balance update soon, as right now it's pretty easy to blast through the campaign.Changes:Restored Renpy "history" feature (bottom of screen) so you can see prior chatlog, by popular request.Thieving content update - several new large missions!
